text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unlike during the Osaka Hai, the fans have come with high expectations for Agnes Tachyon in this year's autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon shows no sign of nervousness as she makes her way to prove once and for all who the medium-distance champion is.
